Name: temporal_feature_comparison
Title: Temporal vs Spectral Features: Comparing MFCC, Mel-Spectrograms, and Raw Waveforms for TinyML Drone Detection
Experiment: Compare the model size, accuracy, and inference latency when using different audio feature extraction methods (MFCCs, Mel-spectrograms, raw waveforms with 1D convolutions) for drone detection on microcontrollers.

Name: knowledge_distillation
Title: Teacher-Student Knowledge Distillation for Ultra-Efficient Drone Audio Detection
Experiment: Train a large 'teacher' model for maximum accuracy, then distill knowledge into a compact 'student' model suitable for microcontrollers, comparing performance against directly trained small models.
